metadata.name: 智能词汇库
metadata.description: 精选高质量英语词汇，按主题分类

words.definition: The occurrence and development of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.
words.example: A fortunate stroke of serendipity brought the old friends together after decades.

words.definition: A pleasant smell frequently accompanying the first rain after a long period of warm, dry weather.
words.example: The petrichor filled the air as the summer rain began to fall.

words.definition: Lasting for a very short time.
words.example: The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral, lasting only a few weeks each spring.

words.definition: Green with grass or other rich vegetation.
words.example: The verdant hills stretched as far as the eye could see.
The pristine wilderness was untouched by human development.

words.definition: Sweet or musical; pleasant to hear.
words.example: Her mellifluous voice captivated the entire audience.

words.definition: A feeling or state of intense excitement and happiness.
words.example: The team felt euphoria after winning the championship.
The tranquil lake reflected the mountains perfectly.

words.definition: Filled with or characterized by a lively energy and excitement.
words.example: The children were exuberant on the last day of school.
She maintained a serene expression despite the chaos around her.

words.definition: Full of or shedding light; bright or shining.
words.example: The luminous moon cast a silver glow over the landscape.

words.definition: Extremely delicate and light in a way that seems too perfect for this world.
words.example: The dancer moved with an ethereal grace across the stage.

words.definition: Of such excellence, grandeur, or beauty as to inspire great admiration or awe.
words.example: The view from the mountain peak was absolutely sublime.

words.definition: Attractive and impressive through being richly colorful or sumptuous.
words.example: The bride looked resplendent in her wedding gown.
The exquisite craftsmanship of the jewelry was evident in every detail.
